# Vendored upstream code

`two_pool_ode.py` is a **verbatim, unmodified** copy of
`/storage/kiran-stuff/proteostasis-P1/two_pool_ode.py`, vendored so this paper
reproduces without depending on a sibling project's working tree.

It is imported by `../09_supraadditivity.py`, which uses only `Params`,
`J_curve_two`, `A_qs`, `saddle_node_operational`, `steady_state` and
`f_codon_from_J`. The Monte Carlo entry points are not used, so the module's
hardcoded absolute path to `ecoli_proteome_with_genes.tsv` (reached only via
`_load_empirical_lengths`) is never exercised.

Do not edit this file. If the upstream model changes, re-copy it and re-run
`scripts/run_all.py`; the test suite will catch any number that moves.
